title: Staff
description: Every academic and non-academic staff member.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, employee no., job title or phone

form.newDescription: An employee number is given automatically. Only the marked essentials are needed now; the rest can be added later.
form.addedInvited: Staff member added. An invitation was sent to {email}.
form.name: Full name *
form.emailHint: Only needed if they'll have a login.
form.emailLocked: This is their login email, so it can't be changed here.
form.giveLoginHint: They'll get an email to set a password. Not everyone needs one, and it can be added later.

profile.noLogin: No login. This person doesn't sign in to Whizchool.

loginStatus.invited: Invited: they haven't set a password yet.
loginStatus.deactivated: Login stopped: they can't sign in.

profile.leaveDescription: Their record stays, marked as left. Their login stops straight away and they come off the subject teacher lists.
profile.leaveBlocked: They still have these classes. Open each class and assign a new teacher, then come back.
profile.returnDescription: They become current staff again. Add them back to subject teacher lists in School settings, and turn their login back on in Users if they need it.
profile.giveLoginDescription: An invitation to set a password goes to {email}.
profile.giveLoginNoEmail: Add an email address to their record first.
